# himmel

> A harness that runs Claude Code as a managed, PR-gated agent that can run unattended: hooks, git gates and guardrails enforce the workflow at the tool-call layer instead of asking the model to remember prose. Memory is durable, hand-editable markdown (handover files plus an optional companion vault), not a vector DB.

Working **inside** this repo? Read [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) first, the authoritative rule set. Just **pointed at** it to set it up? Start at Install. Everything below is a router: open the linked file.

## Install

himmel is a harness *for* [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) — install that first. The wizard checks the prerequisites (`git`, `bash` 3.2+, `node`, `jq`, `python3`; `gh`, `bun` optional).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yotamleo/himmel
node himmel/scripts/himmelctl/bin.js install --scope project   # or --scope user
# node-less machine? run first: bash himmel/scripts/himmelctl/bootstrap.sh
```

Four independent axes:

- **Scope** — `project` wires the target repo's `.claude/settings.json`; `user` wires `~/.claude/settings.json` (you, in every project). Change it later with `himmelctl scope set <project|user>`.
- **Install profile** — `core` (hooks, git gates, worktree workflow, marketplace plugins), `luna` (companion-vault scaffold), or `all`. Membership: `scripts/install/manifest.json`.
- **Saved install-profile file** — a `*.install-profile.json` preset of every wizard answer, including the release channel; `--scope` loads a shipped one, `--from-profile <file>` your own. Detail: [docs/setup/profiles/README.md](docs/setup/profiles/README.md).
- **Release channel** — `stable` (highest `vX.Y.Z` tag) or `pre` (prereleases too), from `HIMMEL_UPDATE_CHANNEL` or the saved file's `channel`; neither set means a plain `git pull`. Detail: [docs/setup/updating.md](docs/setup/updating.md).

Walkthrough and non-himmel adaptation checklist: [docs/setup/install.md](docs/setup/install.md). Coming from an older himmel install: [docs/setup/migrating.md](docs/setup/migrating.md).

## After install: check for duplicates

Run `bash himmel/scripts/install/scan-duplicates.sh <target-repo>` (read-only). Show its output to the user verbatim and change nothing without their OK. It flags doubled hooks and plugins and pre-1.1.3 leftovers.

## Lifecycle verbs

`/himmel-doctor` (read-only health report; `--fix` repairs the node wiring), `/himmel-update` (harness `git pull` plus marketplace re-sync; Claude Code's `autoUpdate` does **not** deliver himmel), `node scripts/himmelctl/bin.js ensure` (reconcile a drifted install) and `uninstall`, `/luna-upgrade` (upgrade a companion vault). All paths: [docs/setup/updating.md](docs/setup/updating.md).

## Enforcement

Structural, not prose: Claude Code PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks plus `pre-commit` / `commit-msg` / `pre-push` git gates. **Do not read an enumerated hook list from any document; it drifts.** The live inventory is `.claude/settings.json` and `.pre-commit-config.yaml`; every gate's class (HARD / auth-gated / warn-only) and off-switch is in [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md). Off switches are session env vars set in the *launching* shell, never a per-call prefix.

Graph-extraction data egress is fenced by `scripts/guardrails/egress-matrix.json`.
